question: Which is the best-selling product?
sql: SELECT p.ICODE,p.DESC1,SUM(f.NET_SALE_AMOUNT) AS Revenue FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f JOIN Dim_Product p ON f.Product_ID=p.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1 ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which department contributes the highest profit?
sql: SELECT o.Department,SUM(f.Gross_Profit) Profit FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f JOIN Dim_Organization o ON o.Org_ID=f.Org_ID GROUP BY o.Department ORDER BY Profit DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What is the average selling price?
sql: SELECT AVG(MRP) Average_Selling_Price FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics;

question: What is the inventory turnover ratio?
sql: SELECT SUM(NET_SALE_COGS_AMOUNT)/NULLIF(AVG(Inventory_Cost),0) AS Inventory_Turnover FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics;

question: What is the stock-to-sales ratio?
sql: SELECT SUM(CLOSING_STOCK_QUANTITY)/NULLIF(SUM(NET_SALE_QUANTITY),0) AS Stock_To_Sales_Ratio FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics;

question: Which department has the fastest turnover?
sql: SELECT o.Department,SUM(f.NET_SALE_QUANTITY)/NULLIF(AVG(f.Inventory_Cost),0) AS Turnover FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f JOIN Dim_Organization o ON o.Org_ID=f.Org_ID GROUP BY o.Department ORDER BY Turnover DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Which products should I reorder today?
sql: SELECT p.ICODE,p.DESC1,SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_QUANTITY) Stock FROM Fact_Inventory_Sales f JOIN Dim_Product p ON p.Product_ID=f.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1 HAVING SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_QUANTITY)<10;

question: Which products should I discount?
sql: SELECT p.ICODE,p.DESC1,SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_QUANTITY) Stock,SUM(f.NET_SALE_QUANTITY) Qty FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f JOIN Dim_Product p ON p.Product_ID=f.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1 HAVING SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_QUANTITY)>100 AND SUM(f.NET_SALE_QUANTITY)<5;

question: Which products should I promote?
sql: SELECT p.ICODE,p.DESC1,SUM(f.Gross_Profit) Profit,AVG(f.Gross_Margin_Pct) Margin FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f JOIN Dim_Product p ON p.Product_ID=f.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1 HAVING AVG(f.Gross_Margin_Pct)>30;

question: Which products should I discontinue?
sql: SELECT p.ICODE,p.DESC1,SUM(f.NET_SALE_QUANTITY) Qty,SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_QUANTITY) Stock FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f JOIN Dim_Product p ON p.Product_ID=f.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1 HAVING SUM(f.NET_SALE_QUANTITY)=0 AND SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_QUANTITY)>10;

question: Which products should I stock more?
sql: SELECT p.ICODE,p.DESC1,SUM(f.NET_SALE_QUANTITY) Qty,SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_QUANTITY) Stock FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f JOIN Dim_Product p ON p.Product_ID=f.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1 HAVING SUM(f.NET_SALE_QUANTITY)>50 AND SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_QUANTITY)<10;

question: Which products should be displayed at the entrance?
sql: SELECT p.ICODE,p.DESC1,SUM(f.NET_SALE_AMOUNT) Revenue,SUM(f.Gross_Profit) Profit FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f JOIN Dim_Product p ON p.Product_ID=f.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1 ORDER BY Revenue DESC,Profit DESC LIMIT 20;

question: Give me this month's business summary.
sql: SELECT SUM(NET_SALE_AMOUNT) Revenue,SUM(Gross_Profit) Profit,SUM(NET_SALE_QUANTITY) Qty,SUM(CLOSING_STOCK_AMOUNT) Inventory_Value FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics;

question: Show my top 10 products.
sql: SELECT p.ICODE,p.DESC1,SUM(f.NET_SALE_AMOUNT) Revenue FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f JOIN Dim_Product p ON p.Product_ID=f.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1 ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Show my bottom 10 products.
sql: SELECT p.ICODE,p.DESC1,SUM(f.NET_SALE_AMOUNT) Revenue FROM Fact_Financial_Metrics f JOIN Dim_Product p ON p.Product_ID=f.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1 ORDER BY Revenue ASC LIMIT 10;

question: Show all products below reorder level.
sql: SELECT p.ICODE,p.DESC1,SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_QUANTITY) Stock FROM Fact_Inventory_Sales f JOIN Dim_Product p ON p.Product_ID=f.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1 HAVING SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_QUANTITY)<10;

question: Show inventory worth more than ₹50000.
sql: SELECT p.ICODE,p.DESC1,SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_AMOUNT) Inventory_Value FROM Fact_Inventory_Sales f JOIN Dim_Product p ON p.Product_ID=f.Product_ID GROUP BY p.ICODE,p.DESC1 HAVING SUM(f.CLOSING_STOCK_AMOUNT)>50000;
